enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Sleep. Turn to right side. Sleep. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Stretch legs. Sleep. Turn to back. Sleep. Pull blanket up. Sleep.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower tap. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Apply soap to body. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower tap. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body with towel. Wrap towel around body. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl and pan. Close cupboard. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up plate and glass. Walk to sink. Rinse plate and glass. Place in dishwasher. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Select shirt. Select pants. Select socks. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Pack bag with essentials. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Greet colleague. Walk to locker room. Change into work uniform. Walk to work station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Check schedule. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Greet patient. Check patient's vital signs. Record information on computer. Administer medication. Change bandage. Talk to patient. Consult with doctor. Wash hands. Remove gloves. Take a break. Drink water. Return to work. Check emails. Answer phone. Update patient records. Prepare equipment. Clean equipment.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink beverage. Talk to colleague. Check phone. Throw away trash. Return tray. Walk outside. Walk back to workplace. Use restroom. Wash hands. Return to work station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Check schedule. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Greet patient. Check patient's vital signs. Record information. Administer medication. Change bandage. Talk to patient. Consult with doctor. Wash hands. Remove gloves. Take a break. Drink water. Return to work. Check emails. Answer phone. Update patient records. Prepare equipment. Clean equipment.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home. Close door. Take off shoes. Hang up coat.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Wash plate. Place in dishwasher. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV, and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Browse internet. Check social media. Watch video. Type on keyboard. Use mouse. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return to couch. Eat snack. Turn off TV. Turn off computer. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Apply moisturizer. Comb hair. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to bedroom. Change into pajamas. Lie on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Read. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Adjust pillow. Close eyes.
Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Sleep. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to back. Sleep.
